ctgov.note: Only ctgov hit (NCT02561078) is a COMPLETED Eli Lilly-sponsored U-500 insulin study with Insulet as collaborator (Omnipod CSII delivery method). Asset is Lilly's, not Insulet's.

commercial_product.summary: Insulet manufactures and markets the Omnipod tubeless insulin-pump platform. Marketed products include Omnipod DASH, Omnipod 5 (FDA-cleared automated insulin-delivery system with integrated CGMs Dexcom G6/G7 and Abbott FreeStyle Libre 2 Plus), and the on-body Omnipod patch pump for both type 1 and type 2 diabetes. Ongoing R&D is device/software lifecycle (next-gen Omnipod 5 algorithms, additional CGM integrations, expanded insulin compatibility) — not investigational drugs.

excluded_partner_owned.reason: COMPLETED 2017 — Lilly-sponsored U-500 insulin (LY041001) administered via Omnipod; Insulet is collaborator providing the pump, asset is Lilly's.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Insulet is a medical-device company (Omnipod insulin patch-pump platform) with no proprietary drug pipeline. Device development is iterative product/software lifecycle on already-cleared platforms, not active P1/P2/P3 pivotal IDE drug-style trials reportable here.
